opening.argument: The presentation walks viewers through becoming a BitClub member and upgrading an account through a $99 membership package. It connects membership purchase with access to robots from different pools, while the interface labels the relevant sections “Mining Pool” and “Mining Earnings.” The process then redirects to payment pages displaying Bitcoin and Ethereum invoices, QR codes, payment amounts, and a membership-fee line, with instructions to use a digital wallet and enter a payment address. These concrete payment steps and earnings-oriented labels frame the membership as a paid mining opportunity. The record does not establish a guaranteed return, completed payment, recipient, or resulting benefit, and it includes a caution that funds can be lost.

citations.quote: In this video, I explain how to become a member of BitClub Network
buy its membership to be able to opt to buy some robot from the different pools
